summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 6: Modifiers, Add-Ons & Customization. All 13 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend features tested and working: Product detail page with modifier groups, real-time price updates, cart with modifiers showing unique line items, admin modifier management with CRUD operations. Fixed one backend bug in PUT /api/admin/modifiers/:id endpoint.

fixed.issue: 500 error when updating modifier group - options were treated as Pydantic models but came as dicts from model_dump()
fixed.fix: Changed o.id/o.name/o.price_adjustment to o.get('id')/o['name']/o.get('price_adjustment', 0) in server.py line 561

critical_code_review_comments: All frontend API calls correctly use relative URLs (/api/...) to avoid CORS issues
Product detail page correctly fetches modifiers via GET /api/menu/items/:id/modifiers
Required modifier groups show REQUIRED badge and 'Select 1' text with radio buttons
Optional modifier groups show 'Up to N' text with checkboxes
Small is pre-selected by default for required groups, showing 'Included' price
Real-time price updates work correctly when selecting modifiers
Cart correctly creates unique line items for same product with different modifiers using cartLineId
Cart drawer shows modifiers list below item name with group:name and +$price format
Admin sidebar includes 'Modifiers' link between Categories and Orders
Admin Modifiers page shows 4 seeded groups with type badges, option counts, linked item counts
Admin Modifier form has all required fields: name, type, min/max selections, dynamic option rows, linked items grid
seed_data_creation: 4 modifier groups seeded on startup: Size (required, all items), Add-Ons (optional, all items), Temperature (required, drinks only), Protein Choice (optional, mains only)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 modifiers fully tested. All features working: (1) Product detail page at /product/:id shows modifier groups fetched from /api/menu/items/:id/modifiers, (2) Required groups use radio buttons with REQUIRED badge, optional use checkboxes, (3) Real-time price updates when selecting modifiers, (4) Price breakdown shows base + modifiers, (5) Cart creates unique line items for same product with different modifiers using cartLineId, (6) Cart drawer shows modifiers list with prices, (7) Admin at /admin/modifiers shows 4 groups with type badges, option previews, linked item counts, (8) Admin form at /admin/modifiers/new has name, type, min/max, dynamic options, linked items grid. Apple and Facebook social login buttons remain MOCKED (visual placeholders only).

bug_fixed.root_cause: In server.py line 561, options from body.model_dump() are dicts, not Pydantic models. Code was using o.id, o.name, o.price_adjustment which fails on dicts
